name: Laris Geardawdle
summary: In Ironforge's Hall of Explorers, Laris Geardawdle studies oozes across Azeroth. The gnome researcher gives his academic life to their strange nature and origins, and welcomes adventurers who bring him noxious slime samples.

sections.title: Scholar of Slime
sections.body: In the Library of the Hall of Explorers, Laris Geardawdle studies how oozes begin. His dwarven colleagues pore over Titan tablets and ancient stone carvings, but Laris searches the vile, gelatinous horrors of Azeroth for alchemical and biological secrets. He asks roving explorers to gather caustic samples from remote corners of the world. With them, he tests his unusual ideas about how these mindless puddles of malice come to life.

faq.answer: Laris Geardawdle is a gnome researcher in the Library of the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. He studies oozes and slimes, and the strange way they come into being.

faq.q: Where can I find Laris Geardawdle?
faq.answer: You can find Laris Geardawdle in the northern wing of Ironforge, inside the Hall of Explorers and its Library.

Laris Geardawdle studies oozes because his curious, eccentric mind has led him to form theories about how living slime begins. He believes caustic residue from different oozes can help explain how these strange organisms form and replicate.

faq.q: What tasks does he offer adventurers?
aliases: a little slime goes a long way
faq.answer: Laris Geardawdle asks travelers to collect ooze samples in dangerous lands. In A Little Slime Goes a Long Way, he gives them empty ooze containers and sends them to Felwood to take samples from oozes they slay, then asks them to seek pure, uncorrupted samples.

angles.text: As a gnome, you share Laris Geardawdle's drive to seek knowledge in places everyone else overlooks, even if that means reaching into foul swamp muck.
As an Alliance member, you can find Laris Geardawdle at the Hall of Explorers. His work adds eccentric natural science to the League's historical digging.
